claims.claim: OpenAI Astra possesses an active context window of 1.05 million tokens and a maximum generation output of 128,000 tokens.
claims.quote: Astra features a 1.05M-token context window with up to 128k output tokens, enabling end-to-end multi-repository refactoring.

claims.claim: Astra achieves 72.6% task completion on OSWorld 2.0, outperforming GPT-5.6 Sol at 65.7%.
claims.quote: On OSWorld 2.0 evaluation suite, Astra successfully completes 72.6% of diverse multi-app computer tasks compared to 65.7% for Sol.
claims.counter_evidence: Third-party validation on completely held-out non-public tasks reports slight variance between 68-71%.

claims.claim: Astra crosses the Critical threshold in OpenAI's Preparedness Framework for autonomous cybersecurity exploitation and defense.
claims.quote: Astra is the first frontier model evaluated to reach our internal Critical threshold for autonomous cyber operations.

claims.claim: Astra operates via direct operating system primitives: screen capture observation, keyboard events, and mouse coordinates, rather than text APIs alone.
claims.quote: The model takes raw display framebuffers as inputs and emits mouse cursor coordinates and keyboard keycodes.

claims.claim: In real-world environments, unhandled exceptions and modal dialogs cause cascading error loops requiring human recovery in 27.4% of long-horizon tasks.
claims.source: Developer Field Report: Production Failure Modes
claims.quote: Cascade failures occur when an unexpected dialog blocks UI focus, causing repeated retries without backtracking.
claims.counter_evidence: OpenAI claims heuristic backoff reduces modal hang-ups to below 12% in sandboxed environments.
